messages.subject: ddply() seems to be stuck
parts:
I have a situation where I asked ddply() to crunch I rather large data set.  ("How large?" you ask?  I can't tell you at the moment because it's stuck!  Probably ~1M records)  I turned on the text progress bar and it got to 25% but has been hanging out there for 2 days.  Although it was doing some work in parallel initially it seems to be in a serial phase because only one core is active.  Lack of memory is not the issue either.  Has anyone else ever experienced this?  Could it be that the children that were spawned for the parallel work died ungracefully and the parent is waiting for returns that are never going to happen?  I would be glad to provide more details but this may be one that is difficult to reproduce unless you want to step through my massive processing workflow.  If anyone has any thoughts I am all ears.  Thanks.


Neil Best

Computation Institute
University of Chicago

what you want to do; you have only said that you are using ddply
without a hint of what it you are trying. There may be other ways of
approaching the problem. I have never waited 2 days for something to
complete, much less a half hour. I usually starting looking at other
approaches, but since we don't know what you are trying to do, there
are no suggestions to make at this point.
